title: The night that made Kratos the Ghost of Sparta in God of War
subject: kratos
description:
Could you ever forgive Ares? 👇

How a desperate pact with Ares turned a Spartan captain into the Ghost of Sparta. Spoilers for the original God of War.

scenes.text: Kratos once killed his own wife and daughter without knowing it.
Years earlier, the young Spartan captain was losing a battle to a barbarian horde.
Facing death, he begged Ares for power and swore his life to the god of war.
But that's not the worst part. Ares wanted a servant with nothing left to love.
So in a blind rage, Kratos stormed a village temple where his wife Lysandra and daughter Calliope were waiting.
